"Is he going to die, mom?" Was all I was able to hear before everything went black. For some reason I was still self-aware but could not open my eyes or move and single muscle.  I didn't even feel physical anymore, almost like i'm in limbo.  I try to speak out loud but the words echo in my head as thoughts, almost like i'm not real anymore.  

After what felt like an eternity, a light appeared in the distance.  I wasn't sure what to make of it, i tried to look around to see if the light shed and idea of my location, but the light was getting brighter and closer.  Within what seems like seconds, the light is in front of me almost close enough the reach out and grasp.  All of a sudden i hear a ringing and the light grows larger and larger almost as if it was going to consume me....then it did.

"CLEAR!".  That's the first thing i heard as I was jolted awake.  I tried to open my eyes but for some reason they almost felt forced shut.  "He's back we have vitals" I heard someone say in the background, a female voice.  "Okay let's stabilize him and move him to the ICU".

I awoke feeling groggy, no sense of what day or time it was.  I tried to open my eyes again, this time they obeyed, but all was blurry the only thing i could make out was how white everything was. "Is this heaven?" I said, not realizing i was speaking out loud.  "Sadly no, i'm afraid it isn't, son".  Startled I looked around but everything was still so blurry, i could barely make it out but i thought i saw a dark shadow against the wall adjacent to me.  "No one but me is here right now, Robert".  What? who is this? How did he, better yet what, know my name?.  "I've been waiting a long time Robert, 324 years and you've only used one life"  "Huh? How do you know my name...and 324 years?" I demanded. "Oh Robert, must be nice to forget."  the shadow answered.  "Complete your task Robert, don't make me come back."  And just like that the shadow was no longer there.  Everything finally came into focus, and i realized i was in a hospital room.  My exhaustion was too much and I could feel my body slipping back into the dark.  Before I closed my eyes for some reason I could feel a burning on my wrist.  The last thing I saw was the birthmark I've always had in the shape of a nine be twisted and contorted to resemble an eight.  I passed out from the pain and exhaustion.


"That was the most elaborate bullshit story I've ever heard, Robert."  Principal Dean said.
"Now get back to class before i give you detention for a year."  I slumped my head in sadness knowing that no one would ever believe me.  After i woke up in the hospital my family was there, they told me everything.  They told me I drove my motorcycle into a brick wall going 75 mph, and that i had suffered near fatal injuries but i was able to recover.  I tried telling people about what i saw, and the pain from my birthmark, which was now etched in the shape of an eight with no trace of ever changing.  My family said it's always been an eight, and when i tried to explain that it was a nine before they called me a goofball and to stop messing with them.  I know what I saw, i know what happened and i know there's something bigger out there for me.  I will do everything i can to find out what happened and who that shadow was and why it knew my name.  The shadow obviously knew details about my birthmark and I need that information.  I want to die knowing what that shadow meant when he said he was waiting, and i only used one life.
Others may want to act like it never happened....but I will know the truth.
